title: Domino and Tromino Tiling
goal: Count tilings of a two-by-n board using dominoes and trominoes.
strategy: Full and partial frontier states collapse to a recurrence: full(n)=2*full(n-1)+full(n-3). The additional term accounts for the paired staggered frontier patterns introduced by trominoes.
